verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a git client with an AI Repository Agent that can modify files, commit and push, so asking whether agent actions can be tested in an isolated sandbox is a fair question. The evidence documents no sandbox or test environment, and no dry-run mode either. Offline local clones, separate commit and push steps, and undoing unpushed commits are ordinary git workflow features, not a product-provided sandbox isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
